title: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd - acquisition of Lamar Engineering
industries: Manufacture of bins and stationary compactors

timeline.event: Transpacific acquired the business and assets of Cardiff Close Pty Ltd (trading as Lamar Engineering).
ACCC commenced review under Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
ACCC requested further information from Transpacific. ACCC timeline suspended.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC received further information from TPI. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Transpacific acquired the business and assets of Cardiff Close Pty Ltd trading as Lamar Engineering.
body_sections.Market definition: Manufacture and supply of waste bins and stationary compactors in Victoria.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 8 November 2007, the ACCC announced its decision not to oppose the acquisition by Transpacific of the business trading as Lamar Engineering from Paul and Andrea Pugliese. The ACCC considered the information provided by Transpacific and other information available to it. Based on that information, the ACCC considered that the acquisition of the business trading as Lamar Engineering was unlikely to remove a significant source of competitive constraint in the relevant markets. A key factor in reaching this view was the fact that (in relation to the relevant markets) there are a number of alternative competitive providers which will remain available to customers.
